result.summary: Several layout and content overflow issues: restaurant names and delivery info are clipped, category chips overflow the screen, and overlapping text on the ramen card.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated on the last Fastest near you card.
issues.suggestion: Allow wrapping, slightly smaller type, or ensure the carousel card width fits the full name.

issues.description: Tokumaru Ramen Bar delivery line shows overlapping/garbled text ('25-30elivery') instead of a clear time and fee.
issues.suggestion: Fix the time/fee string layout so '25–30 min' and delivery cost do not collide or clip.

issues.description: Category chips (Healthy and the next item) are cut off at the right edge with no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add peek of the next chip and/or a fade/scroll indicator so users know the row is scrollable.

issues.description: The last Fastest near you card is clipped at the right edge, hiding part of the image and ETA badge.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal padding or card width so the last visible card isn’t abruptly cut off.
